options_considered: C01 rate; C02 RR irregularity; C03 axis; C04 amplitude; C05 quality; C06-C12 delineation-based concepts
provisional_decision: Proceed to pilot with C01, C02 (descriptive wording) and C05; defer C03, C04 and delineation concepts
evidence_strength: moderate for C01; weak for C02 validity; none for C03/C04
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: no detector validated on 12-lead 500 Hz resting arrhythmia ECGs; irregularity validity at 10 s not established

provisional_decision: Primary VR_mean = 60/mean(RR) = 60*m/(t_n-t_1); secondary VR_median; report both and m
evidence_sources: S26 (NN vs RR definitions); S02 (device rate definition not documented)
evidence_strength: definitional, no source dictates mean vs median
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: cannot be validated by detector accuracy; device VentricularRate definition unknown

options_considered: CV_RR; NRMSSD; MAD-based; sample entropy; conventional SDNN/RMSSD labelling
provisional_decision: CV_RR, NRMSSD and MADSD on all detected RR, called a 10 s RR irregularity statistic, not HRV
evidence_sources: S25 (10 s validity in sinus, finger pressure, inflated agreement) S26 (ultra-short controversial) S33 (60-RR windows for AF burden)
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: sinus-rhythm evidence does not transfer to AF/flutter/ectopy; Task Force standard unreadable (S27)

options_considered: Pan-Tompkins-type; Hamilton; Elgendi two moving averages; EngZee Mod; WQRS; Kalidas SWT; WFDB xqrs
provisional_decision: No winner declared; pilot compares >=2 detectors of different principle (A energy-based, B two moving averages; optional C via reference package)
evidence_sources: S13 S14 S15 S16 S17 (S18 S19 S20 unreadable)
evidence_strength: moderate generic evidence; none for our domain
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: evidence from single-lead 250-500 Hz sets and noise stress; some detectors tuned on MIT-BIH; S14 results only summarised

options_considered: single lead II; best-lead selection; consensus across independent channels
provisional_decision: Per-lead detection then consensus over the 8 independent channels (I, II, V1-V6); beat time = median of supporting leads
evidence_sources: S02 (II = I+III; aVR+aVL+aVF = 0); S13 (multilead fusion suggested as a remedy)
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: consensus rule not validated on this dataset

provisional_decision: Use raw integer signal in header units; detector-specific band-pass for timing only; fixed delay or zero-phase; never reuse backbone z-scored input
evidence_sources: S13 (5-15 Hz PT; 0.05-40 Hz Butterworth pre-filter) S17 (XQRS 5-20 Hz) S04
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: filtered signals unusable for amplitude/ST; raw-vs-denoised status unknown

options_considered: single SQI score; layered (structural, signal, detector, concept, physiological)
provisional_decision: Five layers with three states per concept (VALID, UNRELIABLE, UNDEFINED) and reason codes
parameter_label: all thresholds [DEV] or [ENG]; clipping limits +/-32767 [CITED S01]
evidence_sources: S21 (SQI definitions, arrhythmia warning) S22 (12-lead 500 Hz acceptability grading) S13 (flat-line example)
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: SQIs validated on single-lead ICU data; bSQI origin unverified (S23/S24 blocked)

options_considered: mask AF/flutter/ectopy/wide QRS; mask only measured limitations
provisional_decision: Never mask by diagnosis or abnormal rhythm; mask only measured limitations; keep physiologically undefined separate from unreliable
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: abnormal morphology may still lower detector reliability -> UNRELIABLE for review, not excluded

provisional_decision: Optional L0/L1 flag using II = I+III and aVR+aVL+aVF = 0 with tolerance from training data

options_considered: net QRS amplitude/area in I and aVF; least-squares over limb leads; delineation-based
evidence_sources: S31 S32 S06 S10; S28 unreadable
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: no accessible validated method or standard; wide-QRS window problem; calibration; circular comparison needed

options_considered: per-lead peak-to-peak or R/S amplitude; clinical low-voltage classification
provisional_decision: DEFERRED; amplitude is a measurement, low voltage a classification needing an authoritative definition
evidence_sources: S29 S30 (inconsistent, unofficial); S01 S02 (calibration conflict, denoising)
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: calibration unresolved; raw vs denoised unknown; official criteria unreadable

options_considered: trust header 1000/mV; trust 4.88 uV/bit; test on data
provisional_decision: Test on DEV-S in Step 4.3 (value-step histogram; band power >60 Hz and <0.5 Hz)
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: needs waveform samples; informs deferred concepts only

options_considered: LUDB; QTDB; MIT-BIH; INCART; PTB-XL; PTB-XL+; CPSC2018; figshare Diagnostics; CSE
provisional_decision: LUDB (closest format) plus MIT-BIH/INCART for R-peak validation; PTB-XL/PTB-XL+/figshare only as coarse or machine-generated comparisons; CSE unreviewed
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: domain mismatch (fs, leads, population); no expert amplitude/quality reference exists openly

options_considered: expert from scratch; expert correcting algorithm output; no expert
provisional_decision: Independent from-scratch R-peak annotation, blinded, double on >=25%, adjudication; fallback without expert
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: expert availability unknown; blinding to rhythm imperfect

provisional_decision: Coverage reporting by label/batch/duplicate group, plus mask-only diagnostic control, both later

options_considered: convenience; simple random; stratified stress plus representative
provisional_decision: Group-level deterministic hash sampling; DEV-S 120 stress, LOCK-S 120 stress, LOCK-R 100 representative; seed 20261111
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: stress sets are not representative; sizes justified by planning arithmetic only

options_considered: scipy-only implementations; install NeuroKit2/wfdb for reference implementations
provisional_decision: Not decided; scipy-only arms A and B feasible now; arm C needs approval
remaining_extrapolation_or_risk: fidelity of home-made implementations to original algorithms cannot be claimed

provisional_decision: Track ID block, timestamp presence, age-missingness as covariates; never as model inputs
